correctness.rationale: Exact published Apéry theorem gives W(T)=m c(T)+2T. A proved ±1 Mersenne coin lemma and a new identity c(h+t)=1+c(t+1) reduce both neighboring Apéry inequalities to integer bounds 2 and 2+δ. Counting ±1 increments telescopes to the exact full gap set and cardinality for all n≥3. Exhaustive independent checks n=2..10 corroborate; no finite-to-infinite inference.
